newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA, HOIU GAIN SLIGHTLY, TRADE QUIET.
newsitem.headline: HANSA, HOIU GAIN SLIGHTLY, TRADE QUIET.

text.p: * Total morning trade 15 million kroons.
* Talse index up 0.30 percent to 303.24.
* Hoiupank most active on 6.4 mln kroons, higher
at 170.20/170.75 kroons vs 169.90 kroons.
* Hansapank was higher with 1.8 mln kroons traded
at a spread of 169.30/171.00 vs 168.90 kroons.
* On the free market, Norma was most active in 2.4
million kroons trade to be higher at 80.25/80.35 vs 79.65
kroons.
* Dealers said Hansa and Hoiu were expected to close stable
to higher as investors are waiting for consolidated half-year
results.
Trade on the Tallinn bourse was
quiet on Tuesday morning and Hansapank and Hoiupank, the leading
shares, gained slightly.
Hoiupank was higher at 170.20/170.75 kroons compared to
169.90 kroons and Hansapank higher at 169.30/171.00 compared to
168.90 kroons.
Dealers said their closing prices were seen stable to higher
despite a slight fall on Monday due to some buying pressure
ahead of consolidated half-year results.
On the free market, Norma was most active and
traded higher at 80.25/80.35 compared to Monday's 79.65 kroons.
The share has been traded actively for the last week as the
market waits for its half-year profit figure.
Privatisation vouchers traded 1.6 million kroons at a spread
of 0.31/0.33 kroons compared to 0.33 kroons on Monday.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn newsroom, +372 6209 201,
reuters@reuters.ee
